records.text: Aircraft can trick their transponders, and the relevant flights to Provo do not appear normally on flight-radar records.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It's going to look to you like this tail number SU-BTU. is just flying around in circles in Cairo, I have been able to confirm that they are able to trick their transponders and they can leave the nation. So it is a fact. You're not going to be able to see some flight radar.

verification.notes: FAA material confirms ADS-B/GPS signals can be spoofed, fail, or broadcast erroneous data, and public flight trackers can therefore have gaps or incorrect tracks. No authoritative source reviewed confirms that SU-BTU or the alleged Provo flights used spoofing, failed to transpond, or were absent for that reason.
